rationale: This 1992 trade article is a descriptive product roundup of commercial software packages for firms in the chemical process industries (covering EPA/OSHA/DOT regulatory text databases, toxicology/chemistry databases, hazardous chemical listings, and wastewater treatment plant design simulation). It does not examine household or community water or sanitation service access (C1), any legal or administrative mechanism governing service access (C2), empirical evidence or a systematic review (C3), or any water/sanitation access outcome (C4).
plain_vs_narrow_note: Excluded under both narrow and plain Criterion 2 readings because the record is a non-empirical trade overview of regulatory compliance and engineering simulation software for chemical process industry firms, with no household or community water or sanitation service access population or outcome.

evidence_quotes.quote: As the costs of environmental fines continue to rise, many firms in the chemical process industries are looking to software packages to help improve compliance.
Following is a selection of the various types of software available today:
Enpro Version 1 is a comprehensive simulation program for modeling the design and operation of wastewater treatment plants.
